title: Paris-based digital asset data provider Kaiko extends a funding round to $110M led by S&P Global to support 24/7 continuous market data and asset tokenization (Anna Irrera/Bloomberg)
summary: Anna Irrera / Bloomberg: Paris-based digital asset data provider Kaiko extends a funding round to $110M led by S&P Global to support 24/7 continuous market data and asset tokenization — A group of large financial firms including DRW Holdings LLC, Susquehanna and Royal Bank of Canada invested …
